## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Dà bān niè pán jīng* in 36 fascicles — the *Southern Recension* (*Nán-běn* 南本) — is the Liú-Sòng editorial revision of [曇無讖](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%87%E7%84%A1%E8%AE%96) Dharmakṣema's *Dà bān niè pán jīng* 大般涅槃經 ([KR6g0001](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0001), Northern Recension, T0374, 40 fasc.). Re-edited by [慧嚴](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E5%9A%B4) Huìyán and [慧觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E8%A7%80) Huìguān in collaboration with the Liú-Sòng-court Buddhist establishment c. 433–443 CE, the *Southern Recension* combines Dharmakṣema's text with the earlier *Pre-Mahāparinirvāṇa* (*Níyuán jīng* 泥洹經, *Fó shuō dà bān ní huán jīng* 佛說大般泥洹經 [KR6g0022](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6g/KR6g0022)) materials translated by [法顯](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E9%A1%AF) Fǎxiǎn and [佛陀跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BD%9B%E9%99%80%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85) Buddhabhadra, smoothing the text for southern Chinese readers and re-arranging the chapter divisions. The *Southern Recension* and the *Northern Recension* together constitute the canonical East Asian Mahāyāna *Mahāparinirvāṇa-sūtra* corpus.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (433–443) reflects the Liú-Sòng editorial period of Huìyán's collaboration with Huìguān.

The Taishō text (T0375) is established on a particularly rich apparatus including the *Liúbù běn* (Disseminated Edition), *Fú* 福 / *Fúyǐ* 福乙 (Fúzhōu) witnesses.
